summary: An alert was investigated for online transaction 3528764 ($350.04) on card C10835-K2 after the second-generation fraud model assigned a score of 0.992, reflecting a 92.1% historical fraud rate. The transaction was executed via an anonymous proxy on a device marked new to the account (device D000072). Crucially, an in-person transaction occurred in region 494 fewer than five minutes prior, confirming concurrent unauthorized card-not-present activity. Although the transaction matched the cardholder's primary billing region, the timing conflict and anonymous proxy corroborate compromise. The activity was confirmed as card-not-present fraud from a new device, resulting in a card block and case creation.
open_question: Device D000072 has a generic iOS profile and is not currently linked to a multi-card fraud ring. Direct contact with cardholder C10835 to confirm whether they authorized the $350.04 online purchase at 21:38:25 on 2016-12-09 would provide final verification.
